Is Semble a good EMR for a solo GP or consultant starting a private practice?

Semble is designed to be a complete "practice-in-a-box" for solo practitioners, including medical billing software for small practices. We handle your bookings, payments, clinical notes, and patient communication in one place, so you don't need to patch together multiple different tools.
Can Semble help me reduce my administrative workload?

Absolutely. Semble automates the repetitive tasks that consume a solo clinician’s time whether you’re a GP, hospital consultant, pharmacist or allied health practitioner. We reduce the time you spend on non-billable work like sending appointment reminders, chasing payments, and generating invoices. Most solo GPs save 4-6 hours per week on admin.
How does online booking work for my patients?

You get a dedicated booking iframe you can embed in your website. You can link to your bookings page from your website or social media. Patients can see your availability, book their desired service and pay upfront, all without needing to call you.
Is Semble designed to be compliant with UK healthcare regulators like the CQC?
Yes. Semble is built for the UK private healthcare market and is fully compliant with CQC requirements for record-keeping, audit trails and data security.
